comment: CI-04 per-library line-coverage thresholds. Baseline measured 2026-10-23 with GCC 11.4 (--coverage, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug) over the full ctest suite (118/118 passing, 170 .gcda files). Threshold = floor(measured) - 1, i.e. at least one point of headroom below the recorded baseline; do not lower a value without reviewing the coverage report, and raise it deliberately after new tests land. CI measures with Clang/llvm-cov; the one-point margin absorbs toolchain differences in line accounting.
